column1: # comment: "Language alignments \u2014 schema.org + Wikidata. gmeow:Language is registry-INDEPENDENT (a self-minted IRI); these are see-also links, and coreference of language INSTANCES to Lexvo (http://lexvo.org/id/iso639-3/\u2026), Glottolog and Wikidata items is asserted in data with skos:exactMatch + gmeow:authorityLink, not here. Proficiency scales (CEFR/ILR/ACTFL), version lineage, and origin/modality/status value vocabularies are largely CANONICAL \u2014 no maintained external RDF vocabulary covers them faithfully. Scripts and orthographies are grounded in the lang: layer (lang:Script / lang:Orthography), so their alignments live with the grounding vocabulary, not here. The reified gmeow:LanguageProficiency flattens to schema:knowsLanguage / wdt:P1412 only via the EDOAL+FnO projection layer, not by a 1:1 SSSOM claim."
